# Acme RA-6 articulated robot arm (fictional datasheet for tests)

Acme Robotics is a fictional company. This document is test data.

## Technical data

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Rated payload | 6 kg |
| Maximum reach | 900 mm |
| Degrees of freedom | 6 axes |
| Pose repeatability | ±0.03 mm |
| Weight | 24 kg |

## Axis data

Axis 1 range ±170°, maximum speed 180°/s.
Axis 2 range -120° to +120°, maximum speed 180°/s.
